_comment: One file per NZ tax year. Every section names the source its figures were read from (data/sources.json). Do not hard-code any of these numbers in src/ or content/: copy reads them through the build context.

incomeTax.note: IRD's page shows the table 'From 1 April 2025' as the latest; no different table for 1 April 2026 was published on the page when checked. The IR340/IR341 April 2026 tables were checked against these brackets (tests/fixtures/official-examples.json).

acc.note: Rate includes GST. The same IRD page also lists 1 April 2027 to 31 March 2028; that year is not used here.

studentLoan.irdWording: IRD's page says 'For the 2026 tax year the annual repayment threshold is $24,128'. IRD names tax years by the year they end, so that wording reads as 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026. The IR340 and IR341 April 2026 tables (for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027) start deducting just above $464 weekly, $928 fortnightly, $1,856 four-weekly and $2,010 monthly, i.e. the same $24,128 threshold. Recorded in docs/UNVERIFIED.md for the owner to re-check.

esct.note: Bands use the employee's salary or wages plus gross employer contributions for the previous tax year.
